name: Mitosis Time-Lapse Quantification
description: You are a cell biologist analyzing cell division dynamics from a time-lapse fluorescence experiment. Open the built-in 'Mitosis (5D stack)' sample in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Mitosis (5D stack)). This is a multi-dimensional hyperstack with time frames, z-slices, and fluorescence channels. Select the channel that best highlights mitotic events (spindle or chromosomes), create a maximum-intensity Z-projection for each of the available time frames to obtain 2D representations of the field at each time point, and for each projected time frame: apply appropriate thresholding to identify mitotic cells/nuclei, count the number of distinct objects, and measure their total fluorescent area. Track how cell count and total fluorescent area change across all time frames. Save a CSV with columns for time frame index, cell/object count, and total thresholded area to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/mitosis_timeseries.csv. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
